title: Chickpea and spinach curry
summary: A mild, creamy curry from the store cupboard, ready in half an hour.
steps: Chop the onion and garlic and soften them in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then season with salt.

title: Lemon and garlic roast chicken
summary: Chicken thighs roasted on a tray with lemon, garlic and potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Halve the potatoes and toss them on a tray with the oil, garlic and sliced lemon.
Lay the chicken on top, skin up, and season.
Roast for 45 minutes until the skin is crisp and the potatoes are tender.

title: Tomato and basil pasta
summary: Fresh tomatoes cooked down into a quick sauce with plenty of basil.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water.
Meanwhile, fry the sliced garlic in the oil, add the halved tomatoes and cook until they collapse.
Toss the drained pasta through the sauce with the torn basil.

title: Shakshuka
summary: Eggs gently cooked in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, eaten straight from the pan.
steps: Soften the sliced onion and pepper in the oil in a wide pan for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cumin, cook for 1 minute, then pour in the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Make four hollows in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until the whites are set.
Crumble over the feta and serve from the pan.

title: Mushroom risotto
summary: A slow-stirred risotto with browned mushrooms, butter and parmesan.
steps: Fry the sliced mushrooms in half the oil until golden, then set them aside.
Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the rest of the oil.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 20 minutes.
When the rice is just tender, stir in the mushrooms, butter and grated parmesan.
Rest for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Salmon and broccoli traybake
summary: Salmon fillets and broccoli roasted together with lemon and a little soy.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Toss the broccoli florets with the oil on a tray and roast for 8 minutes.
Push the broccoli aside, add the salmon, drizzle with the soy and squeeze over half the lemon.
Roast for 12 minutes more and serve with the rest of the lemon in wedges.

title: Red lentil and carrot soup
summary: A thick, warming soup that costs little and keeps well for lunches.
steps: Soften the chopped onion, carrots and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, then add the rinsed lentils and the stock.
Simmer for 25 minutes, until the lentils have fallen apart.
Blend until smooth and season to taste.

title: Chilli con carne
summary: Beef and beans simmered slowly in a smoky tomato sauce. Even better the next day.
steps: Brown the mince in a large pan, then lift it out.
Soften the chopped onion, pepper and garlic in the same pan.
Stir in the chilli powder and cumin, then return the mince with the tomatoes.
Simmer gently with the lid ajar for 45 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the beans for the last 10 minutes and season to taste.

title: Lemon and sugar pancakes
summary: Thin pancakes, rolled up with a squeeze of lemon and a sprinkle of sugar.
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter and rest it for 10 minutes.
Melt a little butter in a frying pan over a medium heat.
Pour in a thin layer of batter, tilting the pan, and cook for 1 minute on each side.
Squeeze over lemon, sprinkle with sugar and roll up. Repeat with the rest of the batter.

title: Greek salad
summary: Ripe tomatoes, cucumber, olives and a slab of feta. No cooking at all.
steps: Cut the tomatoes and cucumber into chunks and thinly slice the onion.
Put them in a bowl with the olives and lay the feta on top.
Sprinkle with oregano, pour over the oil and season with pepper.

title: Vegetable noodle stir fry
summary: Noodles tossed in a hot pan with crisp vegetables, ginger and soy.
steps: Cook the noodles, drain them and toss with half the sesame oil.
Stir fry the broccoli, sliced pepper and carrot ribbons in the rest of the oil over a high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the grated garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Toss in the noodles and soy sauce until everything is hot.

title: Banana bread
summary: A moist loaf for the bananas going brown in the fruit bowl.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 900 g loaf tin.
Mash the bananas and beat in the melted butter, sugar and eggs.
Fold in the flour and baking powder until just combined.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes before turning out.
